title: AI agents now own shopping; our store must be built to sell in them
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in discovery (NIQ); Amazon says 400M used Alexa for Shopping and wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases; Zalando launched an AI agent. Samsung sees no memory relief before 2028; Asus sees PC prices up nearly 10%.

points.headline: AI assistants start shopping journeys and Amazon wins most checkouts
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Amazon wins 59% of AI-assisted purchases and says 400M used Alexa for Shopping. We should make our listings agent-readable and contest checkout.

points.headline: Retailers are racing to ship their own shopping agents
points.detail: Zalando launched an AI shopping agent and Amazon added 100-plus capabilities to its assistant. We should test our own assistant that guides PC buyers to purchase.

points.headline: Memory costs keep pushing PC prices up with no near-term relief
points.detail: Samsung sees no buyer relief before 2028 and Asus expects commercial PC prices up nearly 10% in 2H26. We should plan pricing, promotions and mix for a long squeeze.

points.headline: Apple moves into touchscreen laptops while memory lifts its costs
points.detail: Apple showed its first touchscreen laptops and forecast a holiday-quarter margin drop on memory costs. We should check how our touch lines are positioned and priced online.
